summary: Review-required audit trail for the live Windows Update cache cleanup card. The app already ships this file-backed cleanup action and the repo cleanup docs describe the same update-cache directories, but the card has not yet been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.

setting.name: Clear Windows Update Cache
setting.casual_explanation: This resets the Windows Update cache directories so update metadata and downloads are rebuilt later.
setting.why_people_change_it: People clear the Windows Update cache when they are troubleshooting stuck update state or forcing Windows Update to redownload its metadata.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Resetting the cache can help with update troubleshooting, but Windows Update will need to rebuild its metadata afterward.
setting.professional_notes: The current app deletes %WINDIR%\SoftwareDistribution and %WINDIR%\System32\catroot2 through FileCleanupTweak. Repo cleanup docs describe the same cache-reset flow and note that update metadata will be downloaded again.
